A. Council Direction Regarding Transient Occupancy Tax (TOT) Ordinance Update To Address TOT Assessments For Corporate Room Block Bookings That Extend Beyond 30 Days
Recommended Action
Staff recommends that the City Council take the following actions:
1. Direct the City Manager and City Attorney to prepare ballot measure language to update the City’s TOT regulations in order to ensure that corporate block hotel bookings which extend beyond 30 days are still required to pay the City’s established TOT rate; and
2. Direct that the City Manager and City Attorney bring the proposed measure back for formal review and consideration at the July 28, 2026, City Council meeting, to allow the City Council the option of placing the item on the November 2026 ballot for vot er consideration.
